name: Rominimal
lineage: Rominimal names a Romanian minimal electronic-music community associated with extended DJ sets, small labels and club gatherings. Rhadoo, Raresh and Petre Inspirescu helped shape its international circulation, while newer practitioners connect the sound with microhouse, deep tech and psychedelic influences.
